themes.label: Dark Abstract Flow
themes.scene: Flowing abstract 3D ribbons and folded silk drifting through a deep matte-black void, their edges catching thin glowing lines of electric blue and violet. Smooth volumetric depth, soft specular highlights, a faint film grain over pure black negative space. Premium modern digital-art wallpaper.

themes.label: Deep Space Void
themes.scene: The profound black of deep space — a lone distant planet rim-lit along one crescent edge, a scattering of razor-sharp stars, faint drifting cosmic dust, and an immense sense of silent emptiness. Long-exposure astrophotography, crisp pinpoint stars, deep true blacks.

themes.label: Cosmic Nebula
themes.scene: A vast glowing nebula unfurling across the dark cosmos — billowing clouds of magenta, teal, and gold interstellar gas, clusters of newborn stars burning bright within, dark dust lanes threading through. Hubble-style cosmic grandeur, luminous color against deep black.

themes.label: Cyberpunk City
themes.scene: A rain-slicked neon megacity at night seen from high above — endless towers drenched in magenta and cyan signage, holographic billboards, flying-vehicle light trails threading the canyons, deep wet shadows and glowing reflections. Cinematic blade-runner mood, high dynamic range.

themes.label: Linux Ricing Minimal
themes.scene: A clean minimalist dark desktop wallpaper in the Linux desktop-ricing aesthetic — a single low-poly gradient mountain-range silhouette against a smooth dark gradient sky with a small soft moon, generous clean negative space, a muted Nord/Dracula palette of deep navy, muted teal, and soft purple. Flat, calm, uncluttered, tasteful.

themes.label: Neon Tech Grid
themes.scene: A dark futuristic perspective grid receding to a glowing horizon line, floating wireframe polygons and thin circuitry traces of cyan and orange, subtle HUD-like geometry and data-flow lines. Sleek sci-fi tech aesthetic, neon glow against a near-black backdrop, crisp vectors.

themes.label: Dark Mountain Nature
themes.scene: Moody jagged mountain peaks under a deep starry night sky, low fog pooling in the valleys, cold blue moonlight raking the ridgelines, and a faint sliver of aurora on the horizon. Atmospheric landscape photography, immense scale, dark cinematic contrast.

themes.label: Fluid Gradient Abstract
themes.scene: A smooth liquid blend of deep indigo, magenta, and teal flowing across the frame in soft blurred waves, with gentle depth and a subtle dark vignette. A sleek modern abstract gradient wallpaper — calm, premium, endlessly smooth color transitions on a dark base.

themes.label: Galaxy Spiral
themes.scene: A grand spiral galaxy seen at a dramatic angle — a luminous golden core, sweeping arms threaded with pink star-forming regions and dark dust lanes, set against a dense field of distant stars in the black of space. Deep-field astrophotography, immense cosmic scale.

themes.label: Bioluminescent Forest
themes.scene: A dark enchanted forest at night glowing with bioluminescence — teal and violet mushrooms and glowing flora lighting a misty forest floor, faint drifting spores catching the light, deep shadow between the trees. Mysterious, cinematic, jewel-like glow against darkness.

themes.label: Abstract Crystal Tech
themes.scene: Floating translucent crystalline shards and faceted glass forms refracting neon light in a dark studio void — glassmorphism and holographic iridescence, sharp reflections and soft caustics of cyan, magenta, and gold. Sleek high-tech abstract, premium and futuristic.

themes.label: Dark Ocean Waves
themes.scene: An aerial view of a dark stormy ocean at night — moonlit foam tracing swirling abstract patterns across near-black water, deep swells and subtle texture, a minimal high-contrast composition. Moody fine-art aerial photography, silver light on black sea.
